model_name: 主线强度与周期位置 V4
guardrails: Strength and price-cycle position remain separate axes.
A short rebound is only a startup watch; startup confirmation requires aligned 5-day, 10-day, and 20-day price evidence.
The V4 5-day, 10-day, and 20-day returns use exact completed-session intervals.
Startup confirmation requires at least six of the latest ten closes and at least three consecutive closes above their rolling MA20.
Startup confirmation requires real constituent breadth; news-covered stock count is never used as breadth.
A still-declining 10-day MA20 trend is allowed only when the exact 10-day return is at least 8 percent and every other confirmation gate passes.
Price and technical evidence must match the requested trade date or the cycle fails closed as stale data.
V2 and V3 daily snapshots are immutable and are never rewritten by V4.
The model is research-only and never places orders or changes selection scores.
